name: wp-whatsapp-social-engine-only
description: [ENGINE EXTENSION] Engine classifies whatsapp.com/wa.me (also telegram, discord, threads, redd.it, pin.it, fb.com) as organic social. Plugin SOCIAL_REFERRER_RULES has only facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter/t.co/x.com, reddit, pinterest.com, youtube, tiktok.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #7): engine social-host breadth kept as intentional addition; each host pinned with its own fixture at freeze. Canonical source name 'whatsapp' per ruling #4.
